jobs.title: Protective Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description: Practical experience with OSINT, WEBINT, web investigations, online due diligence, and social media monitoring (military, private, or public sector) Knowledge of open-source research methodologies (e.g., Boolean logic) and online research environments (forums, message boards, etc.) Knowledge of web intelligence techniques (including deep and dark web), link analysis, data mining, and other online intelligence tools
